tours.title: Tashkent tours to Amirsoy and Chimgan
tours.lead: Amirsoy, Chimgan, Charvak and Beldersay are all inside a two-hour drive. Add the old city, the metro and the bazaars, and you have a week without repeating yourself.
tours.section-title: Tours to Amirsoy and the Chimgan mountains
tours.section-lead: The Western Tian Shan starts about eighty kilometres from your front door. These four are what guests ask for most, and every one of them starts with the driver picking you up where you are staying.

hero.photo: The Amirsoy gondola line rising over the Western Tian Shan ridges above Tashkent in clear morning light, pine forest below the cable, layered blue mountain silhouettes fading into the distance, wide landscape composition, warm sunlit slopes against cool shadows, no people in frame, 4:3 landscape.

groups.mountains: The Western Tian Shan begins about eighty kilometres from the city centre, and the road there climbs through orchards, reservoirs and river gorges before the ridges appear. These four mountain tours are the ones guests ask for first, and any two of them fit comfortably into a long weekend.
groups.city: Tashkent rewards slow walking more than most capitals. The old city keeps its bazaars, madrasahs and bread ovens running the way they always have, and the metro underneath it is a museum you can ride through for the price of a token.
groups.winter: From December to March the same slopes turn into a ski area with modern lifts, rental gear at the base and almost no queues on weekdays. We drive you up in the morning, wait while you ski, and bring you back to the apartment in the evening.
groups.day-trips: The Afrosiyob high-speed train puts Samarkand two hours away and Bukhara within reach of a very long day. We book the tickets, meet you at the station on both ends and arrange a local guide, so a day trip stays a day trip.

practical.title: Practical notes before you book
practical.lead: The mountains around Tashkent change completely between seasons, and the difference between a good day and a cold one is usually a jacket and a start time. Here is what we tell every guest before they choose a date.
practical.season-caption: Best seasons for each type of tour from Tashkent

amirsoy.best: December to March, June to September
amirsoy.note: Skiing in winter, gondola and alpine meadows in summer

chimgan.note: Cable car, ridge views, snow above 2,000 m from November

charvak.note: Warm enough to swim, boats on the reservoir

beldersay.note: The hiking season, wildflowers in May, a long ridge walk

city.note: Bazaars and the metro work in any weather

bring.layers: Layers rather than one thick coat — the mountains run ten degrees colder than the city
bring.shoes: Shoes with grip for anything above the cable car station
bring.sun: Sunglasses and sunscreen, the altitude is deceptive even in winter
bring.cash: Some cash in som for mountain cafes and the bazaar
bring.water: A water bottle, refilled at the apartment before you leave
bring.passport: Your passport for the Samarkand and Bukhara train

drive.chorsu: Chorsu Bazaar — 20 minutes by car, 4 metro stops
drive.samarkand: Samarkand — 2 hours 10 minutes by high-speed train

practical.pickup-title: Pickup and where we collect you
practical.pickup: Every tour begins wherever you are sleeping. If you are staying in one of our apartments in Tashkent city center the driver simply comes to the courtyard at the agreed time, and if you are in a hotel anywhere else in the city we collect you from the lobby at no extra cost. Guests arriving on an early flight often go straight from the airport into a mountain day, luggage in the boot, which we are happy to arrange as part of the transfer.

amirsoy-day-trip.title: Amirsoy Resort day trip
amirsoy-day-trip.summary: The newest mountain resort in Uzbekistan, ninety minutes from Tashkent, with a gondola that lifts you above the tree line in twelve minutes.
amirsoy-day-trip.photo: The Amirsoy resort gondola rising over snow-dusted Western Tian Shan ridges under a clear winter sky, wide landscape composition, cool-neutral shadows with warm sunlit slopes, pine forest below the cable line, no people in frame, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: The Amirsoy gondola to the upper station at 2,290 m
highlights.two: Panoramic terrace over the Chimgan ridge

chimgan-cable-car.title: Chimgan mountains and cable car
chimgan-cable-car.summary: The classic Tashkent mountain day: the old Soviet chairlift up Greater Chimgan, alpine meadows in summer, deep snow in winter.
chimgan-cable-car.photo: Greater Chimgan peak seen across a green alpine meadow in late spring, an old single-seat chairlift line running up the slope, dramatic layered ridges receding into haze, warm afternoon light, no people, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Chairlift up the shoulder of Greater Chimgan
highlights.three: Horse riding on the meadows in summer

charvak-lake.title: Charvak Lake escape
charvak-lake.summary: A turquoise reservoir ringed by mountains, an hour and a half out of the city. Swimming and boats in summer, empty shorelines and clear air the rest of the year.
charvak-lake.photo: Charvak reservoir from an elevated viewpoint: intensely turquoise water surrounded by bare ochre mountains, a small boat wake crossing the frame, strong midday sun, deep blue sky, no people, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Swimming and boat hire from the north shore

beldersay-hike.title: Beldersay peak hike
beldersay-hike.summary: The walking version of the mountain day. A chairlift start, then a steady ridge climb with the whole Chimgan massif open in front of you.
beldersay-hike.photo: A hiking trail along a high grassy ridge in the Beldersay area of the Western Tian Shan, wildflowers in the foreground, layered mountain ranges fading into blue distance, clear morning light, no people, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Beldersay chairlift to the ridge start
highlights.two: Ridge walk with views over Chimgan
highlights.three: Wildflower meadows in May and June

old-tashkent.title: Old Tashkent: Chorsu Bazaar and Khast Imam
old-tashkent.summary: The half of the city that survived the 1966 earthquake. Domed bazaar halls, madrasahs still in use, and the oldest Quran in the world.
old-tashkent.photo: The blue-domed Chorsu Bazaar hall in Tashkent seen from outside in morning light, mosaic tilework detail on the dome, low surrounding old-town rooftops, warm earthy palette, no people in frame, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: The domed Chorsu Bazaar spice and bread halls
highlights.two: Khast Imam complex and the Uthman Quran
highlights.three: Kukeldash Madrasah and the old town lanes

metro-architecture.title: Tashkent metro architecture tour
metro-architecture.summary: Chandeliers, marble and mosaics thirty metres underground. Photography was banned here until 2018, which is why almost nobody has seen it.
metro-architecture.photo: An ornate Tashkent metro station platform: domed ceiling with cosmonaut-themed mosaic medallions, blue tiled columns, hanging chandeliers, polished marble floor, symmetrical one-point perspective down the empty platform, no people, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Kosmonavtlar station and its cosmonaut medallions
highlights.three: Mustaqillik Maydoni and the older line

bazaar-food-walk.title: Bazaar and food walk
bazaar-food-walk.summary: Chorsu and Alay bazaars on foot with someone who knows which stall to stop at. Plov cooked in a two-metre kazan, samsa straight out of the tandoor.
bazaar-food-walk.photo: A close overhead shot of an Uzbek plov kazan: rice, carrot, chickpeas and lamb glistening under steam, a wooden serving spoon lifting a portion, warm tungsten market light, shallow depth of field, no faces in frame, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Plov from a working kazan at the plov centre
highlights.two: Samsa, non bread and halva tastings
highlights.three: Dried fruit and spice rows at Chorsu

ski-day-transfer.title: Amirsoy and Beldersay ski day
ski-day-transfer.summary: Door-to-door for a day on the snow: pickup before the lifts open, skis and boards arranged in advance, back in the city by evening.
ski-day-transfer.photo: A wide ski slope at Amirsoy on a bright winter morning: fresh corduroy piste, pine trees weighted with snow, a chairlift line crossing the frame, deep blue shadows and warm sunlit snow, no people, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Early pickup so you catch the first lift
highlights.two: Ski and snowboard rental arranged in advance
highlights.three: Beginner slopes and instructors on request

samarkand-day-trip.title: Samarkand day trip
samarkand-day-trip.summary: Two hours each way on the Afrosiyob high-speed train, and a full day among the largest turquoise domes on the Silk Road.
samarkand-day-trip.photo: Registan Square in Samarkand at golden hour: three madrasah facades with turquoise ribbed domes and intricate majolica tilework, symmetrical composition, deep blue sky, long warm shadows across the plaza, no people, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Registan Square and its three madrasahs

bukhara-day-trip.title: Bukhara day trip
bukhara-day-trip.summary: The best-preserved medieval city in Central Asia, reachable and back in a day by high-speed train if you start early.
bukhara-day-trip.photo: The Kalyan minaret and mosque complex in Bukhara at sunrise: sand-coloured brickwork, a turquoise dome behind, empty stone plaza, long soft shadows, warm desert palette, no people, 16:10 landscape.

highlights.one: Kalyan minaret and the Poi Kalyan complex
highlights.two: Lyab-i Hauz pool and the trading domes
